updates.title: Stay logged in across updates (fixes “Cloud not configured”)
updates.notes: This fixes the real reason the app kept logging you out after an update. Your firm's cloud database connection is now built into the app itself, so installing an update can no longer erase it — the app stays connected and you simply sign in with your email and password. (Before, the connection lived only in the phone's local storage, which each install cleared, causing 'Cloud not configured. Open via LegalBill.exe'.) Your data was always safe in the cloud. Tap Install update, then open the downloaded file to install over your current version.
